text_en: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck down, on that very day, the hand of the Lord was upon me, and he brought me there.
text_cn: 我们充军后第二十五年，京城被毁后第十四年，年初，月之初十日， 就在这一天，上主的手临于我。

text_en: He brought me, in visions of God, to the land of Israel, and set me down upon a very high mountain, on which was a structure like a city to the south.
text_cn: 在神视中领我来到以色列地，把我放在最高的山上，山的南方有座像城的建筑物。

text_en: When he brought me there, a man was there, whose appearance shone like bronze, with a linen cord and a measuring reed in his hand; and he was standing in the gateway.
text_cn: 他领我到了那里，看，有一个人，面色似铜，手中拿着一条麻绳和测量竿。他站在门楼旁。

text_en: The man said to me, “Mortal, look closely and listen attentively, and set your mind upon all that I shall show you, for you were brought here in order that I might show it to you; declare all that you see to the house of Israel. ”
text_cn: 那人对我说：“人子，你要用眼看，用耳听，留意我向你指示的一切，因为我引你到这里来，为叫你看见；凡你所见的，你要告诉以色列家族。”

text_en: Now there was a wall all around the outside of the temple area. The length of the measuring reed in the man’s hand was six long cubits, each being a cubit and a handbreadth in length; so he measured the thickness of the wall, one reed; and the height, one reed.
text_cn: 看，在殿外四周有一道围墙。那人手中拿的测量竿长六肘 —— 肘是一肘加一掌 —— 他用竿量了墙：宽一竿，高一竿。

text_en: Then he went into the gateway facing east, going up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate, one reed deep. There were
text_cn: 他来到面朝东的门楼，上了石级，量了门限，宽一竿；

text_en: recesses, and each recess was one reed wide and one reed deep; and the space between the recesses, five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the vestibule of the gate at the inner end was one reed deep.
text_cn: 量了守卫房：长一竿，宽一竿；房与房之间相离五肘；内里门廊的门限，为一竿。

text_en: Then he measured the inner vestibule of the gateway, one cubit.
text_cn: 又量了内里的门廊，

text_en: Then he measured the vestibule of the gateway, eight cubits; and its pilasters, two cubits; and the vestibule of the gate was at the inner end.
text_cn: 为八肘，壁柱厚二肘，门廊是在内里。

text_en: There were three recesses on either side of the east gate; the three were of the same size; and the pilasters on either side were of the same size.
text_cn: 东门楼的守卫房，这边三间，那边三间；三间的尺寸相同，两边壁柱的尺寸也相同。

text_en: Then he measured the width of the opening of the gateway, ten cubits; and the width of the gateway, thirteen cubits.
text_cn: 量了门口的宽度，为十肘；门的通道为十三肘宽。

text_en: There was a barrier before the recesses, one cubit on either side; and the recesses were six cubits on either side.
text_cn: 守卫房前面有栅栏，两边各突出一肘。守卫房各边为六肘。

text_en: Then he measured the gate from the back of the one recess to the back of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, from wall to wall.
text_cn: 量了门楼，由守卫房顶到对面守卫房顶，宽二十五肘；门与门相对。

text_en: He measured also the vestibule, twenty cubits; and the gate next to the pilaster on every side of the court.
text_cn: 量了门廊，为二十肘；通过门廊，即是外院。

text_en: From the front of the gate at the entrance to the end of the inner vestibule of the gate was fifty cubits.
text_cn: 由门楼的前面到内里门廊的前面，共五十肘。

text_en: The recesses and their pilasters had windows, with shutters on the inside of the gateway all around, and the vestibules also had windows on the inside all around; and on the pilasters were palm trees.
text_cn: 门楼四周，在守卫房和墙壁上，有向内斜带棂的窗户；走廊四周也有这样向内的窗户。壁柱上有棕榈枝。

text_en: Then he brought me into the outer court; there were chambers there, and a pavement, all around the court; thirty chambers fronted on the pavement.
text_cn: 他引我到了外院；看，有廊房，在庭院四周修的有铺道，铺道上有廊房三十间。

text_en: The pavement ran along the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.
text_cn: 在各门楼旁边也有铺道，同门楼一样长，这是低铺道。

text_en: Then he measured the distance from the inner front of the lower gate to the outer front of the inner court, one hundred cubits.
text_cn: 他由下门楼前面，量到内院门楼前面，共一百肘宽。然后他向北走去。

text_en: Then he measured the gate of the outer court that faced north—its depth and width.
text_cn: 看，在外院有一座面朝北的门楼。他量了门楼的宽和长。

text_en: Its recesses, three on either side, and its pilasters and its vestibule were of the same size as those of the first gate; its depth was fifty cubits, and its width twenty-five cubits.
text_cn: 守卫房，两边各有三间；壁柱和走廊，如上面所有的尺寸一样：五十肘长，二十五肘宽。

text_en: Its windows, its vestibule, and its palm trees were of the same size as those of the gate that faced toward the east. Seven steps led up to it; and its vestibule was on the inside.
text_cn: 窗户、走廊、棕榈枝、如朝东的门楼所有的尺寸一样。上去的台阶有七级，直达面前的走廊。

text_en: Opposite the gate on the north, as on the east, was a gate to the inner court; he measured from gate to gate, one hundred cubits.
text_cn: 外北门的对面有一座通内院的门楼，与东门楼一样；量了门楼与门楼的距离，为一百肘。

text_en: Then he led me toward the south, and there was a gate on the south; and he measured its pilasters and its vestibule; they had the same dimensions as the others.
text_cn: 他又领我往南走，看，朝南有一座门楼；他量了壁柱和走廊，尺寸与前面的相同。

text_en: There were windows all around in it and in its vestibule, like the windows of the others; its depth was fifty cubits, and its width twenty-five cubits.
text_cn: 走廊四周也有窗户，一如上述的窗户。门楼五十肘长，二十五肘宽。

text_en: There were seven steps leading up to it; its vestibule was on the inside. It had palm trees on its pilasters, one on either side.
text_cn: 上去的台阶有七级，直达面前的走廊；两边的壁柱上都有棕榈枝。

text_en: There was a gate on the south of the inner court; and he measured from gate to gate toward the south, one hundred cubits.
text_cn: 通内院朝南也有一座门楼。量了二门楼之间的距离，为一百肘。

text_en: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it was of the same dimensions as the others.
text_cn: 他领我由南门走进内院，量了南门楼，尺寸与上述者相同。

text_en: Its recesses, its pilasters, and its vestibule were of the same size as the others; and there were windows all around in it and in its vestibule; its depth was fifty cubits, and its width twenty-five cubits.
text_cn: 守卫房、壁柱和走廊，一如上述的尺寸；走廊四周也有窗户；门楼五十肘长，二十五肘宽。

text_en: There were vestibules all around, twenty-five cubits deep and five cubits wide.
text_cn: 四周共五十肘长，二十五肘宽。

text_en: Its vestibule faced the outer court, and palm trees were on its pilasters, and its stairway had eight steps.
text_cn: 门廊面向外院；壁柱上也有棕榈枝。上去的台阶有八级。

text_en: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gate; it was of the same size as the others.
text_cn: 他引我到了面朝东的内院门楼，量了门楼，尺寸有如上述。

text_en: Its recesses, its pilasters, and its vestibule were of the same dimensions as the others; and there were windows all around in it and in its vestibule; its depth was fifty cubits, and its width twenty-five cubits.
text_cn: 守卫房、壁柱和走廊，尺寸有如上述；走廊四周也有窗户。门楼长五十肘，宽二十五肘。

text_en: Its vestibule faced the outer court, and it had palm trees on its pilasters, on either side; and its stairway had eight steps.
text_cn: 门廊面向外院；两边壁柱上也有棕榈枝。上去的台阶有八级。

text_en: Then he brought me to the north gate, and he measured it; it had the same dimensions as the others.
text_cn: 他引我到了北门楼，量了门楼，尺寸有如上述。

text_en: Its recesses, its pilasters, and its vestibule were of the same size as the others; and it had windows all around. Its depth was fifty cubits, and its width twenty-five cubits.
text_cn: 守卫房、壁柱和走廊，四周也有窗户；门楼长五十肘，宽二十五肘。

text_en: Its vestibule faced the outer court, and it had palm trees on its pilasters, on either side; and its stairway had eight steps.
text_cn: 门廊面向外院；两边壁柱上也有棕榈枝。上去的台阶有八级。

text_en: There was a chamber with its door in the vestibule of the gate, where the burnt offering was to be washed.
text_cn: 在门楼的门廊两旁，各有一间有门的厢房，在里面洗涤全燔祭牲。

text_en: And in the vestibule of the gate were two tables on either side, on which the burnt offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering were to be slaughtered.
text_cn: 在门廊两边，每边两张桌子，在上面宰杀全燔祭、赎罪祭和赎过祭牺牲。

text_en: On the outside of the vestibule at the entrance of the north gate were two tables; and on the other side of the vestibule of the gate were two tables.
text_cn: 在登上门廊的入口处的北面，靠外的一面有两张桌子，在门廊的另一面也有两张桌子。

text_en: Four tables were on the inside, and four tables on the outside of the side of the gate, eight tables, on which the sacrifices were to be slaughtered.
text_cn: 门楼旁边，每边有四张桌子，共八张，在上面宰杀祭牲。

text_en: There were also four tables of hewn stone for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, and one cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high, on which the instruments were to be laid with which the burnt offerings and the sacrifices were slaughtered.
text_cn: 又有四张为全燔祭用的桌子，都是四方石头砌成的：长一肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘；上面放宰杀全燔祭牺牲和其他祭牲的用具。

text_en: There were pegs, one handbreadth long, fastened all around the inside. And on the tables the flesh of the offering was to be laid.
text_cn: 屋内四周钉有一掌长的挂钩，桌上放有祭肉。

text_en: On the outside of the inner gateway there were chambers for the singers in the inner court, one at the side of the north gate facing south, the other at the side of the east gate facing north.
text_cn: 他领我走到内院，看见在内院中，有两座厢房：一座靠北门的厢房，面朝南；一座靠南门的厢房，面朝北。

text_en: He said to me, “This chamber that faces south is for the priests who have charge of the temple,
text_cn: 他对我说：“那面朝南的厢房是为在殿内供职的司祭之用，

text_en: and the chamber that faces north is for the priests who have charge of the altar; these are the descendants of Zadok, who alone among the descendants of Levi may come near to the Lord to minister to him. ”
text_cn: 那面朝北的厢房是为在祭坛前供职的司祭之用，他们是肋未的后代中，走近祭坛供职的匝多克的子孙。”

text_en: He measured the court, one hundred cubits deep, and one hundred cubits wide, a square; and the altar was in front of the temple.
text_cn: 他量了庭院：长一百肘，宽一百肘，为四方形；在殿前有一祭坛。

text_en: Then he brought me to the vestibule of the temple and measured the pilasters of the vestibule, five cubits on either side; and the width of the gate was fourteen cubits; and the sidewalls of the gate were three cubits on either side.
text_cn: 他领我进了圣殿的门廊，量了门廊的壁柱，两边各有五肘。门宽十四肘，墙壁每边三肘。

text_en: The depth of the vestibule was twenty cubits, and the width twelve cubits; ten steps led up to it; and there were pillars beside the pilasters on either side.
text_cn: 门廊长二十肘，宽十二肘；上去的台阶有十级。靠着壁柱，有二柱，每边一柱。
